SELECT TOP 1 Id, Guid, RecordGuid, WorkflowDefinitionId, CurrentStep, CurrentOwnerRoleCode, LastActionCode, StartedDate, CompletedDate, IsCompleted, IsCancelled
FROM InstanceWorkflow
WHERE RecordGuid = @RecordGuid
ORDER BY Id DESC;
CurrentStep, owner, action và cờ kết thúc khớp UI.

SELECT Id, WorkflowDefinitionId, ActionCode, FromNodeId, ToNodeId, StatusId, StatusName, IsReturn, IsEnd, IsActive
FROM StepsWorkflow
WHERE WorkflowDefinitionId = @WorkflowDefinitionId
  AND ActionCode = @ActionCode;
Action tồn tại, active và route đúng node.

SELECT Id, Code, WorkflowDefinitionId, IsActive, LastActionCode
FROM WorkflowInstanceNode
WHERE WorkflowDefinitionId = @WorkflowDefinitionId
  AND Code = @CurrentStep;
CurrentStep thuộc đúng definition và node active.

SELECT RecordGuid, WorkflowDefinitionId, COUNT(*) AS InstanceCount
FROM InstanceWorkflow
WHERE RecordGuid = @RecordGuid
GROUP BY RecordGuid, WorkflowDefinitionId;
Một record không có instance active trùng.

SELECT Id, ActionCode, StatusName, IsEnd, ToNodeId
FROM StepsWorkflow
WHERE WorkflowDefinitionId = @WorkflowDefinitionId
  AND ActionCode IN ('CLIENT_CONFIRMED','CLIENT_REFUSED','LMKT_DECLINED');
Action kết thúc phải đưa runtime về trạng thái phù hợp.

SELECT Id, ActionCode, NotificationTemplateId, MailTemplateId
FROM StepsWorkflow
WHERE WorkflowDefinitionId = @WorkflowDefinitionId
  AND IsActive = 1;
Template ID được tham chiếu phải tồn tại.
